column1: # Where the series the home dashboard queries come from, for tests/dashboards.bats: a metric name
# (an anchored regular expression), a tab, then the monitor of the render that scrapes the target that
# serves it as Kind/name, any-monitor for the series Prometheus writes for every target it scrapes, or
# alerting-rule for the series it writes for every alerting rule. A series a recording rule of the
# render writes needs no row. The test fails when a monitor named here is not in the render, and a
# metric the dashboard queries that no row names has no known source.
